description: gonic: a lightweight music streaming server with a Subsonic API, podcasts, playlists and transcoding, with the admin password set at install and your library mounted read-only. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Maddy: an all-in-one mail server (SMTP MX and submission, IMAP, DKIM, SPF, DMARC) with mailboxes on a volume and native TLS. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
